ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default correlationId, "name": attributes.headers.name, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId, "source": attributes.headers.source }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentNumber": payload.documentNumber, "documentType": payload.documentType as String }

%dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var identity = vars.getIdentityResponse.identity[0] var model = vars.initialPaylad.model.technology var startDate = now() as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} var endDate = if (identity.fecha_consulta?) (identity.fecha_consulta as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}) else startDate --- identity match { case i if isEmpty(i) -> "NUEVO_REGISTRO_DE_VALIDACION" case i if i.estado != "VIGENTE" -> "ACTUALIZACION_NO_VIGENTE" case i if i.estado == "VIGENTE" and (daysBetween(endDate, startDate) > 30) -> "ACTUALIZACION_VIGENCIA_CADUCADA" else -> "VALIDACION_EXITOSA" }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "nombres": vars.initialPayload.names, "apellido": vars.initialPayload.firstLastName, "segundo_apellido": vars.initialPayload.secondLastName, "fecha_exp": vars.initialPayload.dateExpedition, "num_doc": vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, "tipo_doc": vars.initialPayload.documentType, "fecha_consulta": now() as Date, "estado": "NO VIGENTE", "causal": "" }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentType": vars.initialPayload.documentType as String, "documentNumber": vars.initialPayload.documentNumber }

os:store.doc:name: store validation values
os:store.os:value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { identityId: vars.postLisimResponse.id, documentNumber: vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, documentType: vars.initialPayload.documentType, technology: vars.initialPayload.model.technology, segment: vars.initialPayload.model.segment }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "200", message: vars.postLisimResponse.messageServer default "validacion exitosa", result: { "id": vars.postLisimResponse.id, "type": vars.postLisimResponse."type", "questions": vars.postLisimResponse.questions, "otpCode": vars.postLisimResponse.otpCode, "matchType": vars.postLisimResponse.matchType } }
